run_evaluate_mlir_attention: run the evaluate function to assess MLIR attention optimization parameters and return speedup metrics
run_mlir_optimizations: run MLIR optimization passes on attention IR using mlir-opt with a configurable pass pipeline
analyze_ir_complexity: analyze MLIR intermediate representation to count operations, loops, memory ops, and nesting depth
estimate_performance_from_ir: estimate performance speedup from IR metrics by comparing optimized and baseline operation counts
verify_mlir_tools: verify that required MLIR tools like mlir-opt are available on the system path
